record.category: cloud-to-cloud transfer service (not a file host)

free_tier.stated: Free: '5GB / Month' of data transfer, across 30+ cloud services, with 5 one-way/two-way sync modes and offline transfer.
free_tier.notes: The 5 GB is transfer volume through MultCloud, not storage; MultCloud stores nothing of its own.

per_object_cap.stated: not stated on the page read

retention.stated: not applicable: MultCloud moves bytes between accounts the user already owns and keeps no copy

egress.terms: Transfer is metered by volume through the service: free 5 GB/month, then 100 GB/month at $19.99. 'Offline transfer/sync/backup' is included even on free.
egress.price_per_tb: USD 19.99 per 100 GB per month, or USD 119 per year for unlimited

record.interface_detail: A web console over 30+ providers, and it accepts WebDAV and FTP as endpoints among them. The 30+ list on the page includes Google Drive, Google Photos, Google Workspace, Dropbox, OneDrive, MEGA, Amazon S3, Box, pCloud, MediaFire, Putio, Backblaze, Yandex, Baidu, NAS, MySQL and Egnyte.
record.tooling: Browser console plus scheduled sync jobs; no rclone backend and no public API was read. rclone covers the same ground for free with a local binary, which is the comparison this record exists to make.
record.chaining: The only service in tested services that moves bytes between two clouds not administered here. The 'Putio' endpoint entry is the debrid-adjacent one: it can pull from a put.io account into another drive without a local machine in the path.

limits.value: 5 GB per month free; 100 GB per month at $19.99; unlimited at $119/year

record.limits_note: Offline transfer (a URL source rather than a cloud endpoint) is included on the free tier, which is the feature that overlaps the debrid topic.
record.binding_note: 5 GB a month free fails at 1 TiB by a factor of 200. The unlimited annual plan at $119 removes the byte counter, and the remaining limit is the provider list rather than a number.

identity_cost.detail: A MultCloud account, then OAuth authorisation of each connected cloud. Payment by card, bank/wire transfer, check or invoice through CleverBridge.

record.reliability_note: Transfers run inside MultCloud's session, so each connected cloud's own rate limits and re-authorisation requirements break jobs silently; a revoked OAuth token stops a scheduled sync without an error the user sees.
record.confidence_note: Every figure read from the vendor's own price page. An actual transfer would raise this to measured and would establish the real throughput.

evidence.proved: '5GB / Month' free, '100GB / Month $19.99', '1200GB / Year $59.99', 'Yearly Unlimited $119', 'Lifetime Unlimited $249', and the 30+ service list including Putio, WebDav and Amazon S3
the four products: cloud transfer, cloud sync, cloud backup, and remote/offline transfer
the free plan publishes 5GB per month, so the unit is GB

record.price_per_tb_month: USD 19.99 per 100 GB per month (about USD 199.90 per TB); USD 119/year unlimited
record.notes: At $19.99 per 100 GB the metered plan is one of the most expensive per byte in tested services; the $119 annual unlimited plan is the only sensible tier and it is still above a debrid subscription. rclone does the same job for nothing on a rented box, which is why this record is a comparison rather than a recommendation.

extras.plans: 5 GB/month free; 100 GB/month $19.99; 1200 GB/year $59.99; Yearly Unlimited $119; Lifetime Unlimited $249
